name: Aldrees Petroleum and Transport Services Company
summary: Aldrees Petroleum and Transport Services Company engages in the wholesale and retail of fuel, gasoline, and oil in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Petroleum Services and Transport Services segments. The company offers various services related to additives, car wash, tire servicing, alignment, accessories, food, mosque, ATMs, car rental, etc.; and operates fuel stations. It also provides transportation and logistics services for liquid and dry materials through trucks and trailers.
